walkthrough:
Set $y = 0$ in the curve equation $y = \frac{1}{16}(3x - 1)^2$ to find the $x$-coordinate of $P$:
$$\frac{1}{16}(3x - 1)^2 = 0 \implies 3x - 1 = 0 \implies x = \frac{1}{3}$$

Evaluate the gradient of the tangent at $Q(3, 4)$:
$$m_T = \left.\frac{dy}{dx}\right|_{x=3} = \frac{3}{8}(3(3) - 1) = \frac{3}{8}(8) = 3$$

Write the equation of the tangent line $QR$:
$$y - 4 = 3(x - 3) \implies y = 3x - 5$$

Find the $x$-coordinate of $R$ where the tangent crosses the $x$-axis ($y = 0$):
$$0 = 3x - 5 \implies 3x = 5 \implies x = \frac{5}{3} \quad \left(= 1\frac{2}{3}\right)$$

hints: Area under curve from $\frac{1}{3}$ to $3$: $\int_{1/3}^3 \frac{1}{16}(3x - 1)^2 dx = \frac{32}{9}$.
walkthrough:
Integrate under the curve from $P(1/3, 0)$ to $Q(3, 4)$:
$$\text{Area}_{\text{curve}} = \int_{1/3}^3 \frac{1}{16}(3x - 1)^2\,dx = \left[ \frac{(3x - 1)^3}{16 \times 3 \times 3} \right]_{1/3}^3 = \left[ \frac{(3x - 1)^3}{144} \right]_{1/3}^3$$

Calculate the area of the right-angled triangle under the tangent line from $R(5/3, 0)$ to $x = 3$ (base $3 - \frac{5}{3} = \frac{4}{3}$, height $y_Q = 4$):
$$\text{Area}_{\triangle} = \frac{1}{2} \times \frac{4}{3} \times 4 = \frac{8}{3} = \frac{24}{9}$$

Subtract the triangle area from the curve area to find the shaded area $PQR$:
$$\text{Shaded Area} = \text{Area}_{\text{curve}} - \text{Area}_{\triangle} = \frac{32}{9} - \frac{24}{9} = \frac{8}{9}\text{ square units} \quad (\approx 0.889)$$
